answer_facts.fact: Relapsed refractory acute myeloid leukemia by World Health Organization (WHO) criteria Patients must have >= 5% blasts in the bone marrow as assessed by morphology or flow cytometry.
However, if an adequate bone marrow sample cannot be obtained, patients may be enrolled if there is unequivocal evidence of leukemia with >= 5% blasts in the peripheral blood
